title: Degreewise monomorphism property of relatively flat single base change
statement: Let Y, B and A be schemes [def-pc-scheme], p : Y → B quasi-compact and quasi-separated, M a quasi-coherent module on Y [pqf-def-coherent] flat over p [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], g : A → B, and n an integer. In the standard derived localization [def-pc-derived-category], the degree-n cohomology map of the explicitly defined canonical comparison β_(p,M,g) [def-pc-standard-single-base-change-map] is a monomorphism of module sheaves on A. This is solely the monomorphism assertion in this one degree.

proof.text: Relative flatness makes the stalk of M[0] K-flat over the base stalk. The fibre-product stalk is flat over the tensor product of the original and new base stalk rings. Thus the localized tensor-cohomology comparison for the single complex is invertible in every degree.

Express the left-derived counit on M[0] in K-flat stalk coordinates; the localized comparison gives its coordinate-independent single-complex stalk condition. The zero terms and M give quasi-coherent cohomology before and after ordinary tensor pullback.

Apply the degreewise monomorphism part of qcqs single-complex induction to the counit and the two termwise quasi-coherent complexes. Expand the pinned single map: its two adjunction comparison factors cancel. The remaining single-complex identification is an isomorphism. Direct image and homology preserve that isomorphism, so postcomposing the degreewise monomorphism retains monicity.

Take degree n of the constructed comparison and retain only its monomorphism assertion. No inverse, complementary cancellation property, or isomorphism of the derived objects is included in this statement.

lean.statement:
theorem standard_flat_single_baseChange_homology_mono
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (hM : M.IsFlatOver p) (g : A ⟶ B) (n : ℤ) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    Mono ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings A.toRingedSpace)) n).map
        (standardSingleBaseChangeMap p M g))
